lines.arrive: The desert. You've been walking since dawn, and your water ran out hours ago.
lines.mirage: It was a mirage. Only hot air, bending the blue of the sky down onto the sand.
lines.ask: But there's a rock, just here.
lines.water: And under the rock: water. There was water here all along.
lines.end: You believed there was water here. There was. You had every reason. But it wasn't the water that made you believe it. Did you know?
lines.back_1: You give up on it, and turn back.
lines.back_idle: You rest a while, then turn back.
lines.back_2: You'll never know it. But you were right. There was water here, under a rock, a step away.
